purpose: Open blockers with an owner and, where the founder is the owner, the G1 exception that justifies it. Any artifact in ARTIFACT_REGISTRY.json with status 'missing' or 'blocked' must reference an entry here.

blockers.statement: EduOS-owned Google OAuth client must be created so the consent screen reads 'EduOS' (roadmap.md White-label section).

The MPBSE panel ships Hindi-default copy (lang=hi, English switch) citing a founder decision of 2026-10-02 that is not recorded in PRODUCT_DECISIONS.md and conflicts with D9/G5 (English-only product).

blockers.statement: The PR #7 security-reconciliation assignment refers to a 'new Lovable security handoff' by description only. No Drive file id, git path or URL was given; Drive (AGENT-REPORTS, INBOX, recent) and the session uploads hold no such file. The handoff's malicious variants and its 401/403 finding cannot be verified.
blockers.resolution_path: Issue the coordinate (Drive file id in AGENT-REPORTS, or commit the handoff text to a branch) and re-issue; the reproduction matrix and hardening in fix/auth-return-hardening stand regardless.
blockers.closure: The founder attached EDUOS_OPEN_REDIRECT_FIX.zip (ART-0010) with a matching SHA-256.

blockers.statement: Signed-out calls to protected server functions return HTTP 200 with an 'Unauthorized: No authorization header provided' error body instead of HTTP 401 (Lovable live matrix, staging, 11 functions). Data is not exposed; the status code is wrong.
blockers.resolution_path: Separate assignment: make requireSupabaseAuth throw a Response with status 401 (or map the thrown error to 401 in the server-function error middleware) and add route tests. Not part of the open-redirect hotfix.

blockers.statement: Centre-admin server functions called by educator/parent/reviewer return HTTP 200 with 'You do not have permission' instead of HTTP 403. Founder-only functions already return a real 403 (requirePlatformOwner).
blockers.resolution_path: Separate assignment: make the role guards (requireRole / admin checks) throw a 403 Response like requirePlatformOwner does, with tests. Not part of the open-redirect hotfix.
